base: Create a finished standalone artwork suitable as a framed painting texture in an elegant stylized 3D auction-house game. OUTPUT ONLY THE ART ITSELF, full-bleed flat rectangular image scanned straight-on. Absolutely NO picture frame, no mat, no room, no wall, no furniture, no perspective tilt, no cast shadow, no watermark or signature. Rich professional painterly detail that reads clearly at medium distance, cohesive old-world collector aesthetic, harmonious with teal walls, walnut furniture, brass accents. Not a photograph of artwork.
